title: Resin to Rosin
description: Changes "Resin Bricks" to the proper "Rosin Bricks".
body: With the Pale Garden came Resin Clumps, and with Resin Clumps came Resin Bricks. Unfortunately, someone at Mojang didn't do their homework, because when tree resin is purified with heat, the resulting solid is actually called "rosin". This pack remedies that by renaming Resin Bricks and their derivatives to Rosin Bricks. I hope someone else is as pedantic as I am about this.
